name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Two buffer modes. Predictive: if clicking now would kill you, your click is held back and the mod fires its own click at the first moment that survives. Classic: a click made in the air is remembered and fired when you land. Includes per-tick wave correction, orb assist and a noclip toggle.

enabled.name: Enable Buffer
enabled.description: Turn the buffer on or off without restarting.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: You can't die to spikes, blocks or saws. Also toggleable with the NC button in the top-left of a level.

mode.name: Buffer mode
mode.description: Predictive: holds back a click that would kill you and fires its own at a moment that survives. Classic: remembers a click made in the air and fires it when you land.

classic-ticks.name: Classic: buffer window (ticks)
classic-ticks.description: Classic mode only. How long before landing a click is remembered. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS, 240 ticks = 1 second.

wave-enabled.name: Wave assist
wave-enabled.description: Predictive mode only. Checks the wave every physics tick and corrects holds and releases that would hit a spike or block. Your input is left alone when it is safe.

wave-lookahead-ticks.name: Wave: look-ahead (ticks)
wave-lookahead-ticks.description: How far ahead the wave controller simulates each tick. Lower this if the game stutters in wave.

wave-react-ticks.name: Wave: react window (ticks)
wave-react-ticks.description: The wave only overrides you when death is within this many ticks. Higher = earlier saves, but it takes over more often.

orb-assist.name: Orb assist
orb-assist.description: If you click shortly before an orb, the mod re-presses the button the moment you touch it.

orb-window-ticks.name: Orb: early click window (ticks)
orb-window-ticks.description: How early before an orb a click still counts.

max-delay-frames.name: Predictive: maximum wait (frames)
max-delay-frames.description: Predictive mode only. The longest a click may be held back after landing while waiting for a safe moment. 1 frame = 4 physics ticks at 60 FPS.

lookahead-ticks.name: Predictive: look-ahead (ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: Predictive mode only. Upper limit on how far ahead each prediction runs. Ground modes stop earlier, a few ticks after the simulated landing. 240 ticks = 1 second.

hold-ticks.name: Predictive: hold length (ticks)
hold-ticks.description: Predictive mode only. How long each click is held before the mod releases it. The prediction uses the same value.

time-budget-ms.name: Predictive: time budget per check (ms)
time-budget-ms.description: Each safety check is cut off after this long. A check that runs out of time holds the click and tries again next tick. Too low and the mod can't decide in time; too high and the game may stutter.

debug.name: Debug messages
debug.description: Show a short on-screen message for every decision the buffer makes.
